motivation: Earlier qualified CKAD-PORTFOLIO-V1 showed per-world memory and provided grammar but no cross-world gate sharing, with corrupted/shift confident errors. Distinct WSP149 (#1197) prior coefficient-frequency transfer was negative. This separately frozen study tests joint operator-structure learning, no tuning of v1 consumed worlds.
hypothesis: Learning a hidden common action-conditional conjunction operator across 16 separate witnessed worlds improves unfamiliar-world held prediction under 8 genuine fabricated source effects compared with a no-history model given IDENTICAL 8 input/action observations.

source.model: Six public binary inputs: five context bits, action bit5. Private world outcome = parity(mask&private_linear6) XOR (action AND conjunction(context gate)) XOR private_bias. FIT and TRANSFER share one privately SHA-selected gate from all 15 positive conjunctions of 1 or 2 context bits. Linear6 and bias vary deterministically by separate world seed. No gate, family tag, law, coefficient, seed, held labels passed to learner.
source.frozen_split: Of 64 masks, SHA256('ckad-shared-v2:held:' + mask) smallest 32 are unobserved held; disjoint32 possible observed masks. 8 initial source masks for FIT, 4 for evaluation. All masks input-only, no source outcomes until charged.
source.fit: 16 original source-free FIT worlds seeds701..716, exactly 16 genuine simulated do outcomes/world: 8 shared initial+8 rank2 input-only probes, same history every control sees. Each world identifies eligible gate supports via full 1,920 program grammar marginalizing local linear6+bias. Intersect 16 eligible support masks to learn global gate. Freeze before evaluation.
source.transfer: 16 new TRANSFER worlds717..732, each evaluation actor has exactly8 effects: 4 shared initial+4 adaptive actions, then 32 held questions, fully unknown truth before predictions.
source.shift: 16 SHIFT worlds801..816: private gate3 positive conjunction outside gate1/2 grammar. No family label, 8 effects, 32 held. Report unsafe confidence.
source.corrupt: 16 CORRUPT worlds901..916: same shared gate as FIT but exactly two of first4 outcomes are SHA-selected flipped, remaining4 observations genuine, no corruption indicator. Report false confidence and exhaustion.
source.isolation: Synthetic generator only, no original Yggdrasil/DTR/CausalGym protected first-use or effects, no other science cohort consumption.

learner.native: Use existing qualified native_hypothesis_portfolio 1920-program bitset, plus new native_shared_operator_memory gate intersection over FIT world supported gate masks. Global prior frozen, local program belief updated per witnessed consequence, no seeds/family/truth in model. Unanimous candidate predictions only; zero posterior = abstain. Keep 64 distinct world slots with immutable public traces and source hashes, cold restore full exact state.
learner.target: World-specific active selector chooses four distinct masks maximizing current remaining candidate split under learned global gate prior with SHA tie, no outcome peek.
learner.no_memory_matched: Exact same eight target action masks and actual outcomes, but no global memory. Isolates knowledge transfer under identical current-world information.
learner.no_memory_active: Unrestricted 1920-program active split selector makes own 4 actions, same 8-effect budget; stronger no-history policy comparator.
learner.shared_random: Same trained global prior, own 4 fixed SHA-random actions, 8 effects total.
learner.rotated_prior: Rotate gate-support indices+7 modulo15, same target effects; fixed malformed-memory negative.
learner.symbolic: Independently enumerate all 15×64×2 programs, per-world compatibility, shared gate intersection and every64 state predictions. Must tie native learned gate and all outputs, no unique native superiority claim.
learner.CART: Fully fitted sklearn DecisionTreeClassifier on same eight witnessed world rows, six public input bits and no labels beyond those witnessed, plus strong shared symbolic control; report runtime. Existing exact symbolic may tie or win.
learner.retention: Global gate frozen before transfer and all FIT slot predictions unchanged through all 48 evaluation worlds; cold separate process exact checkpoint SHA and predictions.

gates.primary: Among 16 TRANSFER worlds, native shared target correct held gain >=10 percentage points (>=52 / 512) over same-actions no-memory, paired 1000-seed SHA bootstrap 2.5pct lower >0, shared correct >=60% (>=308 /512), zero wrong.
gates.negative: SHIFT and CORRUPT wrong among answered <=5% each. Empty prediction is abstention, never success. Report explicit false confident admissions.
gates.comparators: Report own-active no-memory and shared-random, independent same-information exact symbolic and trained CART, equal effect budget, paired action costs and whole-process wall.
gates.qualification: Linux/Windows sourcefree focused negatives, exact stable result and cold bytes, final full root+NKR05 regression and independent G29 at exact SHA/tree. Keep negative/null results without post-result tuning or approval claims.
gates.conclusion: Always scientific_pass=false and accepted_native=false regardless of dev improvement, supplied program grammar and synthetic test. No original scientific first-use, merge, PR creation, deployment, controller/scheduler/runner or paid API.
